bio: Offering something a little different, this restaurant is located within a residential apartment, but there’s certainly nothing amateurish or domestic about it; it's even licensed. There are six tables – for a maximum of 14 diners – and all guests are asked to arrive at 7pm, which helps contribute to the supper party atmosphere. You ring doorbell 31 and are greeted by your host Igor Zincenco and his team, who go on to fully explain each well-balanced, satisfying dish which features on the modern menu inspired by Hungarian classics....
